title: Building a Portfolio That Stays Easy to Update
excerpt: A short note on moving portfolio content into small data files so the site remains static, fast, and simple to edit.
body: I am keeping this portfolio intentionally static, but the content should not be painful to update. The new setup moves editable copy, projects, and posts into JSON files that Pages CMS can manage through GitHub. That means the site can stay lightweight while still being comfortable to maintain.
